reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: createGeneration is registered as a live route handler in index.ts:75. Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions; entry point is an HTTP POST protected only by authMiddleware, not a trusted internal path. Gate 3: stem-bot-v2/src/api/ is not in out_of_scope. An attacker can trigger this via POST /api/generation (holding API_AUTH_TOKEN) by sending {"generation": -1} or {"generation": "foo"}, causing Discord to create an invalid role (e.g. "-1期生") and the generation_roles table to be permanently corrupted with a non-positive or non-numeric generation key, breaking downstream role-assignment queries.
